_note: Neutral HUD look shared by every world (src/ui/hud_style.gd, src/ui/hud_kit.gd): crypt, Hell-Dungeon and Frostgruft draw the same panels, text and bars, never in a world's own colours. Colours are hex (RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA); sizes in screen px at 1280x720.
_life_note: The life bar of the hero strip (HudKit.life_bar): bar_width / bar_height in px (287 = the old row of ten hearts), badge_height = the level badge beside it. blood_lite is the bar's 1 px top edge and its drifting highlights, blood_glow the pulsing glow. life_ghost_hold / life_ghost_time / life_heal_sweep in seconds (how long the lost chunk stays lit, how long it takes to shrink away, how long the heal light takes to cross the bar); life_pulse_hz / life_low_pulse_hz / life_wobble_hz in cycles per second (the glow's pulse, the pulse when life is low, the surface's wobble); life_low_share = the life share (0..1) below which the bar pulses hard and its frame turns red; life_hit_threshold = the loss in half hearts within one frame that counts as a hit (smaller losses are a drain and just slide).
_pet_note: The companion bar under the hero strip (HudKit.pet_panel): pet_row_height = the row in px, pet_pad its inner margin, pet_portrait the portrait slot (the idle frame sits in it at 1x or 2x, whichever fits), pet_slot / pet_icon / pet_slot_gap the two ability slots on the right with their talent icon (18 px tile, 36 = 2x), pet_bar_height the companion's life bar, pet_key_size the key label (5, 6), pet_number_size the cooldown seconds. pet_portraits: companion kind (talents.json pet.kinds) -> idle frame; a missing file or kind falls back to a drawn glyph. auto = the auto-cast marker's colour (the skill bar's running glow).
